title: CONTINUED CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - HERNANDEZ) relative to declining to extend the term of the Disposition and Development Agreement (Contract…
text:
[Council File 14-1174-S89; CDs 3, 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CONTINUED CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - HERNANDEZ) relative to declining to extend the term of the Disposition and Development Agreement (Contract No. C-131475) (DDA) beyond its current expiration and Close of Escrow date of December 31, 2026 and amending the prior Council action of March 22, 2024 relative to appropriating funding for the Reseda Theatre Rehabilitation Project.
Recommendations for Council actions, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. DECLINE to extend the term of the DDA beyond its current expiration and Close of Escrow date of December 31, 2026.
2. INSTRUCT the Community Investment Department (CID), with the assistance of the City Attorney, to take all necessary steps to effectuate the termination of the DDA in accordance with its terms.
3. AMEND the Council action of March 22, 2024, relative to appropriating up to $128,391, plus all earned interest in CRA/LA Excess Non-Housing Bond Proceeds (EBP) available to Council District 3 from the Reseda/Canoga Park Project Area (Taxable Series 2003-B, 2006-C, 2010-D and Tax-Exempt Series 2003-A and 2010-E) for the Reseda Theatre Rehabilitation Project (C.F. 14-1174-S89) to reduce the appropriation from its current balance of $1,505,385.19 in principal EBP plus earned interest to $1,127,596.19 inasmuch as that amount that has been expended and revert the unexpended balance of $377,789 to its original source (Fund No. 57D CRA EBP Appropriations Account) so it is available for reprogramming to an eligible use.
4. ALLOCATE upon termination of the DDA all AB 1290 funds to the Project, including the $2,600,000 transferred to the Economic Development Trust Fund No. 62L, Department No. 22 (C.F. 14-0425-S16) and any additional AB 1290 funds committed to the Project, up to the total of $4,300,000 (C.F. 14-1174-S113), be transferred/appropriated to the Cultural Affairs Department Trust Fund (Fund No. 844), Department No. 30, Account Number TBD, to fund redevelopment and restoration of the Reseda Theatre.
5. AUTHORIZE that CID, the Controller and/or the City Clerk to make any technical corrections, clarifications or necessary adjustments to effectuate the intent of this Motion.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Continued from Council meeting of November 20, 2026.)
